tasks.title: Refresh AI Factory backlog
tasks.prompt: Review mission.md, AGENTS.md, current PRs, and recent merged work. Improve task_queue.json with focused tasks that use all roles, avoid duplication, and include write_scope/avoid_scope. Do not change application code.

tasks.title: Improve backend architecture boundary
tasks.prompt: Find one small backend architecture weakness around sessions, agents, skills, or settings. Implement a minimal improvement or document a concrete architecture decision. Keep behavior stable.

tasks.title: Improve backend API behavior
tasks.prompt: Implement one focused backend API improvement around agents, sessions, models, skills, or settings. Add tests when practical and keep the diff small.

tasks.title: Improve frontend workflow
tasks.prompt: Improve one frontend workflow for creating agents, sessions, skills, or model settings. Preserve existing API contracts and keep the UI practical.

tasks.title: Improve skill implementation quality
tasks.prompt: Improve one skill implementation or add one missing guardrail around file, code execution, data analysis, or web search behavior. Avoid network-dependent tests.

tasks.title: Improve runtime configuration handling
tasks.prompt: Improve runtime configuration ergonomics while keeping secrets out of the repository. Prefer environment variables and deterministic tests.

tasks.title: Add backend smoke tests
tasks.prompt: Add focused tests for backend app import, settings loading, and one simple API route. Keep tests deterministic and avoid external network calls.

tasks.title: Expand websocket test coverage
tasks.prompt: Add or improve tests around websocket connection management and message handling. Avoid real network calls.

tasks.title: Expand skills test coverage
tasks.prompt: Add tests for one skills_library module. Prefer pure unit tests and temporary directories over real external services.

tasks.title: Review recent merged changes
tasks.prompt: Review recent repository changes for one concrete regression risk, missing test, or maintainability issue. Create a small corrective PR only if the issue is real.

tasks.title: Refactor a small backend area
tasks.prompt: Refactor one small backend area for readability or duplication reduction while preserving behavior. Add or update tests when practical.

tasks.title: Refactor a small frontend area
tasks.prompt: Refactor one small frontend area for readability or repeated logic reduction while preserving behavior and visual layout.

tasks.title: Document setup and operations
tasks.prompt: Improve setup documentation for local development, required secrets, GitHub Actions, emergency stop behavior, and validation. Do not change application code.

tasks.title: Document API and architecture notes
tasks.prompt: Document one area of the backend API, session flow, agent templates, or skill system based on the current code. Do not change application code.

tasks.title: Harden runtime secret handling
tasks.prompt: Audit configuration and runtime data for secret exposure. Prefer environment variables and placeholders. Do not commit real credentials. Keep the diff small and include validation results.

tasks.title: Harden user input handling
tasks.prompt: Find one concrete input validation, path handling, command execution, or file access risk. Implement a narrow fix with tests where practical.
